newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's new defence minister to visit Bosnia.
newsitem.headline: France's new defence minister to visit Bosnia.

text.p: New French Defence Minister Alain Richard will visit his country's troops serving with the international SFOR peacekeeping forces in Bosnia on Saturday and Sunday, his office said on Thursday.
The visit by Richard, who took office after his Socialist party's upset victory in general elections on June 1, will be to mark France's July 14 national holiday which falls on Monday.
Richard's immediate predecessors made similar visits to French troops in Sarajevo, Mostar and elsewhere around July 14 in recent years.
Richard's exact programme was not released.
